summary: IHS Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, announcing a $200 million add-on to its 7.875% Senior Notes due 2030, issued under Regulation S. Proceeds will redeem outstanding 5.625% Senior Notes due 2026, pay fees, and fund general purposes. Settlement is expected around September 9, 2026. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. The filing also includes a conditional redemption notice for the 2026 notes. No equity, M&A, or strategic transaction is involved; the event is ordinary debt capital management.
